close_reason: Fixed: replaced serde round-trip with to_string() after Display impls were added (JMAP-7a8b.16)
description: MemoryBackend send_mdns serializes ActionMode/SendingMode/DispositionType to their wire strings via serde_json::to_value(mode).ok().and_then(|v| v.as_str().map(String::from)).unwrap_or_else(|| fallback). This is roundabout because the types have no Display impl. Once Display is added (see P1 issue), this becomes just format!("{mode}") or mode.to_string(). Fix is blocked on the Display impl issue.
title: serde round-trip to get enum wire string in MemoryBackend send_mdns is roundabout
